lindel.encode:
SELECT
  hilbert_encode([10, 20]::UINTEGER[2]) AS h,
  morton_encode([10, 20]::UINTEGER[2]) AS m;
-- h = 884, m = 408 (both UBIGINT)
lindel.parquet:
COPY (
  SELECT x, y
  FROM (VALUES (3, 5), (1, 1), (7, 0),
               (2, 6), (5, 3), (0, 4))
       AS points(x, y)
  ORDER BY
    hilbert_encode([x, y]::UINTEGER[2])
) TO 'points.parquet' (FORMAT PARQUET);

stochastic.synthetic:
CREATE TABLE synthetic_users AS
SELECT
  i AS user_id,
  dist_normal_sample(170, 8)
    AS height_cm,
  dist_poisson_sample(3.5) AS sessions,
  dist_bernoulli_sample(0.12)
    AS converted
FROM range(10000) AS t(i);
stochastic.inspect:
SELECT function_name, parameters
FROM duckdb_functions()
WHERE function_name LIKE 'dist_normal_%'
ORDER BY function_name;
